title.narrative: How to overcome the challenge of livestock traceability in Brazil.

description.narrative:
Cattle ranching, is widely recognized as the activity most commonly found in recently deforested areas. Consequently, the entire sector, from animal husbandry to industrial processing of beef as a final product has attracted the attention of governments, non-governmental organizations, retail chains and beef and cattle importers. At present, monitoring of indirect suppliers is the main gap that impeding the effectiveness of commitments to effectively control deforestation. In 2020, the high deforestation rates and the scandals associating large meatpacking plants and retailers with the devastation of the Amazon Rainforest again brought the issue to the forefront, causing great commotion in Brazilian and international media and prompting international investors to demand effective measures from the industry to ensure comprehensive control of the supply chain.

Conecta is a tool/platform for qualification, traceability and transparency that provides full coverage of the beef production chain, which operates under voluntary adherence of cattle ranchers and/or rural producers. By joining the platform and using the tool, cattle ranchers authorize the system to access environmental data for their properties and the health data of their herd in the official databases of the states and the Federal Government. With this, the platform is able to aggregate the existing information on direct suppliers, identify related indirect suppliers and conduct new analyses in order to expand the monitoring of the social and environmental situation to the entire supply chain.

This project is structured towards three outcomes that will increase and/or install Conecta in some of the main beef-producing states, create or increase Conecta access to data from official databases and extend Conecta to other rural production chains. With these three outcomes, the expected impact is to reduce deforestation in the cattle and beef production chain, increase environmental awareness and engagement of cattle ranchers, slaughterhouses, retailers and consumers, and ensure that cattle traceability is no longer an unsolvable challenge in Brazil.

description.narrative: I believe that the correct would be to change the name of the indicator to reduction in the area of deforestation instead of %.
